source_facts.ApplyModifier: 66665 returns System.Boolean, parameters Modifier and System.Boolean. A normal return is not proof of actual SP change/payment.
source_facts.threshold: first m_costMinSp selects branch; nonnegative path reads m_costMinSp again after SP. Negative path may free-cast or read independent decoded cost.
source_facts.GE: signed FP SP > wrap64(thresholdQ - EPS); EPS cctor source value is 42950.
source_facts.debit: ReduceSp delta is independent of threshold/cost/maxcharge; low32 NEG then Int32ToFP, independent owner for NewSp, second owner for Apply.
source_facts.NewSp: SP target1; ADD1 for raw >=0, MINUS2 otherwise; magnitude Abs with MIN64 -> FP.MaxValue (MAX64-1). ctor result/callback fields opaque.
source_facts.unknown: Actual decoded payload, virtual/hotfix runtime identity, modifier effects, paid cost, current SP, cast success and full cycle unknown.
